info.title: TradeLocker Brand Socket API
info.description:
Real-time updates for every account of your brand over [Socket.IO](https://socket.io/):
account status (balance, equity, margin, per-position PnL), positions, closed positions and
orders, plus instrument quotes on request.

One connection carries all accounts of your brand for one account type (`LIVE` or `DEMO`).
You authenticate with your **brand API key**; there is nothing to subscribe per account.

## Quick start

1. **Connect.** Socket.IO v4 client, namespace `/brand-socket`, path `/brand-api/socket.io`,
   transport `websocket`, header `brand-api-key: <your key>`, query `type=LIVE` or `type=DEMO`.
2. **Wait for `connection`** with `{"status":"ok","code":"connected"}`. Any `status: error`
   means the handshake was refused and the server closes the socket (see the `connection` channel).
3. **Read the `stream` event.** You first get a snapshot of every account (`AccountStatus`,
   `Position`, `OpenOrder`), then `Property` `SyncEnd`, then live updates.
4. **Quotes (optional).** Emit `subscriptions` with `{"action":"SUBSCRIBE","instrument":"EURUSD"}`;
   quotes arrive on the `subscriptions` event.

```js
import { io } from 'socket.io-client';

const socket = io('https://api.tradelocker.com/brand-socket', {
  path: '/brand-api/socket.io',
  transports: ['websocket'],
  query: { type: 'LIVE' },
  extraHeaders: { 'brand-api-key': process.env.BRAND_API_KEY },
});

socket.on('connection', (status) => console.log('connection', status)); // {status, code, message}
socket.on('stream', (message) => console.log('stream', message));       // {type, ...}
socket.on('subscriptions', (quote) => console.log('quote', quote));     // {type: 'Quote', ...}
socket.on('disconnect', (reason) => console.log('disconnect', reason));
```

`extraHeaders` is honoured by Socket.IO clients for Node.js, Python, Java and .NET. Browsers
cannot set headers on a WebSocket, so connect from your backend.

## Connection settings

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Protocol | Socket.IO v4 (Engine.IO 4) |
| Namespace | `/brand-socket` |
| Handshake path | `/brand-api/socket.io` |
| Transport | `websocket` only (no HTTP long-polling) |
| Auth | header `brand-api-key` on the handshake; the key's scope must be `FULL_ACCESS` or `SOCKET` |
| Account type | query parameter `type`: `LIVE` or `DEMO` |
| Server ping | every 25 s, connection closed after 20 s without a pong |

## Rules that save you a support ticket

- **One connection per API key.** A new connection with the same key can replace the old one,
  which then receives `disconnected` ("Replaced by new connection with the same API key.").
  This holds across account types: a `LIVE` and a `DEMO` connection with the same key compete,
  so use a separate API key for each type you stream. Never share a key between processes.
- **Connect with a `type` your brand has.** A brand is set up for `LIVE`, `DEMO` or both.
  Connecting with a type it does not have is refused with `badRequest`.
- **Back off.** At most 10 connection attempts per 2 minutes per brand and type; above that the
  handshake is refused with `conflict.<environment>-<type>-<brand>`. Do not reconnect in a tight
  loop on any error code.
- **Reconnect after a server-side close.** Socket.IO clients retry on their own after network
  errors and ping timeouts, but not when the server closed the connection (`io server disconnect`).
  On `shutdown` (a deploy) and `connectionError` (the trading session ended), reconnect yourself
  with a short delay. On the handshake errors (`badRequest*`, `forbidden*`, `unauthorized*`),
  fix the cause before trying again.
- **Every connection starts with a full snapshot.** After a reconnect, rebuild your state from the
  new snapshot up to `SyncEnd` instead of merging it into the old one.
- **Numbers are decimal strings** (`"10628.95"`). Parse them with a decimal type, not a float.
  IDs are strings too: position and order IDs exceed 2^53.
- **Fields with no value are omitted**, not sent as `null`. An `AccountStatus` update can omit
  figures it does not carry: keep the last value you received for that account.
- **Ignore message types and fields you do not know.** New ones can be added without notice.

production.title: Production
production.description:
Socket.IO URL `https://api.tradelocker.com/brand-socket` with path `/brand-api/socket.io`.
TradeLocker may give your brand a dedicated hostname; the contract is the same.

`/brand-api/socket.io`. Same keys and behaviour as `development`.

connection.title: connection
connection.description:
Socket.IO event `connection`, sent by the server. Every payload is
`{"status":"ok"|"error","code":"...","message":"..."}`; branch on `code`, show `message`.

**After the handshake**

| status | code | Meaning | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| ok | `connected` | Key accepted, the snapshot follows on `stream`. | |
| error | `badRequest.invalidAccountType` | `type` is missing or not `LIVE`/`DEMO`. | Fix the query. |
| error | `badRequest.invalidApiKey` | The `brand-api-key` header is missing or empty. | Send the header. |
| error | `forbidden.brand-not-found` | No brand has this API key. | Check the key and the environment (development keys do not work in production). |
| error | `forbidden.brandToken.cannotEstablishConnectionUsingRestrictedApiKey` | The key's scope does not allow the socket. | Use a key with scope `FULL_ACCESS` or `SOCKET`. |
| error | `unauthorized.brandSocketDisabled` | The Brand Socket is not enabled for your brand, or the brand is not active. | Ask TradeLocker to enable it. |
| error | `badRequest` | Your brand has no setup for this `type`. | Connect with the other type, or ask TradeLocker. |
| error | `conflict.<environment>-<type>-<brand>` | Too many connection attempts (10 per 2 minutes). | Wait, then reconnect with backoff. |
| error | `internalServer.pfix_conn_fail_<brand>_<type>` | The trading session for your brand could not be opened. | Retry with backoff; contact TradeLocker if it persists. |
| error | `internalServer.externalHttpRequest.failed.<httpStatus>` | An internal service answered with an error. | Retry with backoff. |
| error | `unknown` | Unexpected server error. | Retry with backoff. |

On every handshake error the server closes the socket.

**During the connection**

| status | code | Meaning | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| ok | `disconnected` | Replaced by a newer connection with the same API key, or closed by TradeLocker. | Do not reconnect automatically: another consumer is using your key. |
| ok | `shutdown` | The service is restarting (deploy). | Reconnect after a short delay. |
| error | `connectionError` | The trading session behind the socket ended. | Reconnect with backoff. |

**In reply to `subscriptions`** (the socket stays connected)

| status | code | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| error | `validation.badRequest` | The payload is invalid; `message` lists every problem. |
| error | `notFound` | No such instrument for your brand. |
| error | `notImplemented` | Quotes are not available in your brand's environment. |
| error | `unknown` | Unexpected error handling the request. |

brand-api-key.description: Your brand API key, scope `FULL_ACCESS` or `SOCKET`.

type.description: Account type to stream. Your brand must be set up for it.

stream.title: stream
stream.summary: Snapshot and live updates for every account of your brand.
stream.description:
Socket.IO event `stream`, sent by the server. One event carries one message; the `type` field
says which.

After `connected`:
1. snapshot: `AccountStatus`, `Position` and `OpenOrder` messages for every account of your
   brand and the connected type;
2. `Property` with `name: SyncEnd`;
3. live updates, in the order the trading engine produced them.

Updates for canceled and refused orders are not sent.

subscriptions.title: subscriptions
subscriptions.summary: Quote subscriptions (client to server) and quotes (server to client).
subscriptions.description:
Socket.IO event `subscriptions`, used in both directions:

- **you emit** `{"action":"SUBSCRIBE"|"UNSUBSCRIBE","instrument":"<name>"}`, no acknowledgement
  callback. Success is silent; a failure arrives on the `connection` event and the socket stays
  connected. A request sent before `SyncEnd` is answered once the snapshot is complete.
- **the server emits** a `Quote` for every price change of each subscribed instrument.

subscribeQuotes.title: Subscribe or unsubscribe instrument quotes
subscribeQuotes.description:
The payload takes exactly `action` and `instrument`. Any other property, an unknown action
or a missing instrument is answered with `validation.badRequest`, whose `message` joins every
problem with commas, for example
`property foo should not exist,instrument must be a string`.

brandApiKey.name: brand-api-key
brandApiKey.description:
Brand API key issued by TradeLocker, sent as a header on the Socket.IO handshake. Its scope
must be `FULL_ACCESS` or `SOCKET`. Development and production keys are separate.

Decimal.description: Decimal number as a string. Parse with a decimal type.

Id.description: Numeric identifier as a string; values exceed 2^53.

AccountId.description: Account identifier, `L#<number>` for live and `D#<number>` for demo accounts.

code.description: Machine-readable result; see the `connection` channel for every value.

message.description: Human-readable detail. Do not parse it.

positionPnLs.description: Gross profit and loss of every open position; empty when there is none.

openOrderId.description: Order that opened the position, when known.

stopLossOrderId.description: Attached stop-loss order; omitted when there is none.

maintMargin.description: Maintenance margin held for the position.

takeProfitOrderId.description: Attached take-profit order; omitted when there is none.

stopPrice.description: Trigger price of stop and stop-limit orders.

slPrice.description: Stop loss to attach to the resulting position.

slLimitPrice.description: Limit price of a stop-limit stop loss.

tpPrice.description: Take profit to attach to the resulting position.

trStopOffset.description: Trailing stop offset, `0` when not used.

positionId.description: Position the order opened or closes, once known.

name.description: `SyncEnd`: the snapshot is complete; everything after it is a live update.

instrument.description: Instrument name as your brand lists it.
